narrative: The backtest exhibits robust edge characteristics masked by severe portfolio cash drag. Across 125 executed trades spanning an 11.34-year horizon, the strategy maintains a sub-50% win rate (46.40%) that is effectively compensated by an asymmetric 2.02:1 payoff ratio (₹36,302 avg win vs. ₹17,937 avg loss). This dynamic generates a positive mathematical expectancy of ₹7,229.86 per trade (+3.61% ROI on capital at risk per trade) and a healthy Profit Factor of 1.75. The Fisher-Pearson skewness of +0.18 corroborates disciplined asymmetric risk management with positive tail exposure. However, the 2.0% fixed capital allocation constraint (₹200,000 per position) with minimal overlapping exposures causes extensive capital under-utilization, diluting portfolio-level total return to 9.04% and CAGR to 0.77%, trailing Indian risk-free benchmarks. Conversely, this low exposure caps Maximum Drawdown to just -2.91% (₹-301,816.69) with annualized volatility at 0.90%. To unlock the strategy's statistical edge without breaching institutionally acceptable risk parameters, position sizing should be scaled via a volatility-targeted or fractional Kelly allocation model alongside concurrent multi-position concurrency.
